caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a vessel or chalice with a fluted bowl and a round, sturdy base. The wooden lid is depicted with visible layers and grain, emphasizing its aged appearance and slightly irregular shape. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, off-white in color, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements present. The composition centers the vessel on the page, with the object shown in isolation.
